task.title: Entitlement proven — Part-time employment on a continuing claim

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Employer’s name] — entitlement proven during the labour dispute.”
Details: Document the decision according to the information noted in Major Employer Events . Major Employer Events

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a D5 or an MA74 imposed on the file:

ul.li: If there is a D5 but no MA74 imposed, go to step 3.
If there is no D5 but there is an MA74 imposed, go to step 9.
If there is no D5 and no MA74 imposed, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work type: Select 15- Manual Action code 11, 12 or 14 .
Remarks line 1: Type “Labour dispute — entitled to benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “D5 to be terminated as of [date].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the A-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169) .

step.cmd: In ACS, inform the employer of the decision by sending a Z-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Advising Employer that Claim Approved (2775): Select Approved claim of employee or former employee .

Reason for Claim Approval (2783):
Select the appropriate option.

Messages to Yer - Monies paid to client and Benefit rate for SUB (2788):
Select Warning to ER: To inform us if pays any monies to employee .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there a registration number for the labour dispute issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M106) transaction and complete as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: Complete the WI for the labour dispute issue.
